What we solved · Sample scenario

A change in the weather, without a change in the feeling. An indoor ceremony layout was ready before the first raindrop.

Behind the celebration

Weather & guest movement

The ceremony had two complete layouts. A held indoor space, duplicated floral inventory, and clear transport cues meant the decision could be made without involving the couple.
